sentences.text: ORAL ORDER 1.

Present petition is preferred by the Petitioners under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, seeking quashing of FIR No.11215018240009 of 2024 registered with Mahila Police Station, Anand for the offences punishable under Sections 198A, 504, 506(2) and 114 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and Section 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.

2. Heard learned Advocate for the petitioners and learned APP for the Respondent - State.
3.
Rule. Learned APP waives service of notice for and on behalf of the respondent - State.

4. Learned Advocate for the Petitioners has submitted that the matter has been amicably settled between the parties and NEUTRAL CITATION R/SCR.A/15068/2024 ORDER DATED: 27/11/2025 undefined they are now not willing to proceed with the complaint any further.

sentences.text: 5. Leaned Advocate appearing on behalf of Respondent No. 2 (Original Complainant), who is present before this Court, has placed on record duly sworn in Affidavit dated 20.11.2025.
The same is ordered to be taken on record.
Learned Advocate has submitted that matter has been amicably settled between the parties and there is no objection if present petition is allowed.

The affidavit reads thus:
"1, Sanskriti Lochan Sahai, W/o Mr. Appoorv Prasad, (Maiden Name: Sanskriti Lochan Sahai Dio Pankaj Lochan Sahai) Aged about 31 years, Occupation: Home Maker, Hindu, Female, R/o: Houset No. 23, Sanskar Jyot Society, In front of Hero Showroom, Anand-Lambhvel Road, Lambhvel, Ta. Dist. Anand 6354021431 complainant of complaint registered vide CR. No. 11215018240009 of 2024, under sections 498A, 504, 506(2) and 114 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act with Anand Mahila Police Station, have perused the opy of the petition filed by the petitioners.

That I being conversant ith the facts and circumstances of the case and also competent to epose submit my reply, which is as under:
1. That I am the complainant of Criminal Complaint registered vide CR. No.
11215018240009 of 2024, under sections 498A, 504, 506(2) and 114 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act with Anand Mahila Police Station, NEUTRAL CITATION R/SCR.A/15068/2024 ORDER DATED:
27/11/2025 undefined against the accused named therein.

2. I state that upon the intervention of the prominent members. of the society, elderly persons, friends and mediators, an amicable settlement has been arrived at between me and the accused and since the offences alleged against are personal in nature not affecting any interest of the State Government.
3. I have agreed to compromise the entire dispute including the impugned complaint filed by me and the proceedings that may have arisen pursuant to the filing of the complaint qua the petitioners.

I state and submit that this affidavit is filed without any pressure, coercion or force and I am bound to respect the same and therefore, I accord my consent to this Hon'ble Court to quash the CR. No. 11215018240009 of 2024, under sections 498A, 504, 506(2) and 114 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act with Anand Mahila Police Station,
against the petitioners original accused named in the complaint, which would serve the purpose of justice.

4. That the Petitioner herein filed Family Suit No. 106 of 2025 for Divorce which was withdrawn by the Petitioner and Criminal Misc. petition No. 49 of 2024 filed by the Respondent herein for maintenance, wherein the withdrawn pursis is filed before the Ld. Trial Court and matter is posted for withdrawal purposes in Lok Adalat dated 13.12.2025.

Similarly, NEUTRAL CITATION R/SCR.A/15068/2024 ORDER DATED:
27/11/2025 undefined

2 from Domestic Violence Act, 2005 registered before the Civil Judge Court Anand vide Criminal Misc.
petition No. 363 of 2024 is also withdrawn pursuant to the settlement between the parties.

sentences.text:
5. That the Petitioner pay Rupees 33,50,000/- as a permanent alimony by way of Demand Draft No.
138115 dated 11.11.2025 amount of Rupees 20,00,000/- issued by State Bank of India, Mumbai in favour of Respondent and Demand Draft No. 138123 dated 13.11.2025 amount of Rupees 13,50,000/- and the same is mentioned in the Divorce Petition filed by the Respondent and Petitioner No. 1 herein before the Ld. Family Court Anand vide Family Suit 279 of 2025 listed before Family Court Anand dated 20.12.2025.

6. That Respondent abide by the terms of settlement narrated in Divorce Petition (mutual divorce)
and further assured that Respondent not withdrawn her consent from the same.

7. That Your Lordships may kindly be pleased to quash the present complaint pursuant to the compromise arrived between the parties and consider that divorce petition may be disposed expeditiously by the Family Court Anand on 20.12.2025.

8. I crave leave of this Hon'ble Court to add, amend, alter, remove, delete, rescind or modify any or all NEUTRAL CITATION R/SCR.A/15068/2024 ORDER DATED: 27/11/2025 undefined contentions or averments stated hereinabove."
6. Considering averments made in the Affidavit as also the submissions made by the learned Advocates for the respective parties, the present petition deserves to be allowed and is hereby allowed.
The FIR No.11215018240009 of 2024 registered with Mahila Police Station, Anand
is hereby quashed and set aside.
Rule is made absolute.
